$comment: The weekly loop's PRIVATE runtime config, read by zynkr-ops-weekly, ops-weekly-doc, ops-weekly-tracker and project-manager. Copy to ~/.config/zynkr/ops-weekly.json (never commit). Every value below is a placeholder.

space.name: <space display name>
space.$note: The spaces/ prefix is REQUIRED — get_messages rejects a bare id.

doc.archive_tab_id: <tab id of the archive tab, e.g. t.abc123>
doc.$note: Sections are named by MEETING day (Thursday), not by report day (Monday). The archive tab MUST be a sibling tab in THIS Doc: carryover.py reads all tabs as one stream, so a separate file resets every ↻N週 streak.

chat_ids.$note: The ONLY hardcoded map. Chat gives no email field at all; the Doc gives email and no id. TWO key forms are valid, because the MCP resolves a sender to a DISPLAY NAME when that person is in the account's personal Contacts and leaves everyone else as users/<id>. Keep both when unsure.

main_tracker.$note: snapshot copies this tab; apply writes it. cycle keeps one half-year's item numbers apart from the next tracker's.

ledger.epoch_week: <ISO week of the first snapshot, e.g. 2026-W40>
ledger.$note: The machine-owned Weekly Ledger (SKB-044, references/ledger.md). NEVER change epoch_week after the first snapshot: every week's rows are computed from it.

harvest.$note: The Drive folder the Wednesday weekly-insights routine writes <WEEK>/harvest-<person>.md and run-<WEEK>.json into (SKB-094). collect reads it; nothing writes it but the routine.

meeting.$note: minutes finds the transcript by this title and the meeting's date, never 'the latest'.

routine.$to: recap_to gets the Monday recap and weekly_to the Friday 【週結】. Until recap_to is set, recap_audience (owner | team) and recap_team_from decide, as before.
routine.$name_aliases: Names the Monday Sales Pulse writes that are not a roster name's first word.
routine.$apply_mode: shadow = apply records the owner's decisions in the Ledger and writes nothing to the Main Tracker (default, and what any other value means); live = writes the approved changes.
routine.$sheets_credentials: The OAuth file notes_append.py refreshes a token from, to append a 備註 line without losing its links (live apply only). Missing = this default path.
routine.$notice_from: From this ISO week on, beats that gave up or never ran are mailed to the owner (project-manager notice). Never earlier than the install week; after a mid-week install, the next week. Missing or not a week = no notices.
